entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to return some shoes and a set of tires I recently purchased.
Okay, I can help you with that. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you. I see your order here. Before we proceed, I need to ask: have the shoes or tires been mounted or used in any way?
Yes, I did try them out. I had the tires installed on my bike, and I used the shoes for a couple of rides.

I understand. Unfortunately, because the tires were installed and the shoes have been used, we cannot accept the return. We have a policy against accepting returns for items that have been mounted or used. We cannot resell them as new once they've been used.
Oh, I didn't realize. Even though I only used them a couple of times?

Yes, even a little use impacts the condition. With the tires, once they've been on a rim and rolled, they are considered used, even with minimal wear. Similarly, the shoes, after only a couple of rides, will have signs of wear, like cleat marks, even if they are minor.
I see. So even if the dirty tires and the minimal shoe use isn't obvious, it still violates your return policy?
That is correct. It's a matter of ensuring all our customers receive brand new, unused products. We appreciate your understanding in this matter.
Okay, I understand. I should have read the policy more carefully. I guess I'm stuck with them.

I apologize that we can't accommodate the return this time. Perhaps you could consider selling them privately online or donating them to a local cycling club? I can offer you a discount code for 15% off your next purchase at VeloFit, as a gesture of goodwill. Would that be acceptable?
That would be great, thank you!
You're welcome! I've applied the discount code 'VELO15' to your account. It will automatically apply at checkout on your next order. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help and for the discount!
You're very welcome! Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
